name: idyll
description: Language support for Idyll: syntax highlighting, and, from front/'s language server (`Idyll lsp`), diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, completion, an outline and formatting.

idyll.server.path.description: Path to front/'s executable, `Idyll` (built by `meadow build --release` in front/, at front/target/release/native/silo/Idyll); the extension runs `Idyll lsp`. Left at `Idyll`, it is looked for on your PATH, in $IDYLL_HOME/bin and ~/.idyll/bin, and, in a trusted workspace, at front/target/release/native/silo/Idyll in an open folder.

idyll.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the language server.
